fact: UNDP says it deployed country-hosted AI compute capacity in South Africa under its AI Infrastructure Activation programme.
UNDP's programme procured and deployed country-hosted GPU compute in South Africa.
Vodacom group CTO Dejan Kastelic told Business Day that South Africa will be the last of three large markets where Vodacom plans to install GPUs, starting small and mainly for internal use.

The Stellenbosch University Policy Innovation Lab lists among South African AI tools in deployment the CSIR body and number plate recognition system and the University of Johannesburg facial recognition access control.
